issue: Previously read stories can appear unread after reopening the app or when newer stories arrive.

confirmedPaths.reproduction: Inject one or more SQLite write failures after marking a story read. The old helper clears its timer before writing and drops the error, so a later background flush does not retry and a fresh store loses the mark.
confirmedPaths.fix: Track unsaved changes independently of the timer; clear the dirty flag only after a successful synchronous save.

confirmedPaths.path: Failed initial read is treated as an empty history
confirmedPaths.reproduction: Seed earlier progress on disk, fail the launch getItemSync call, mark a new story, then flush. Before the fix, the saved map is overwritten with only the new story.
confirmedPaths.fix: Distinguish unavailable storage from absent/malformed data; restore and merge existing history before persisting. Block writes until the initial read recovers, and retry at subscription, mark, prune and flush.

confirmedPaths.path: History cap removes a read story still in the current feed
confirmedPaths.reproduction: Mark an old story, declare it live, and add more than 600 newer progress records. Before the fix, the still-live story is evicted and appears unread.
confirmedPaths.fix: Evict old records outside the current feed first; preserve live stories, allowing a soft-cap overflow only if the feed itself exceeds the cap.

redGreenEvidence.initialFailureCases: Six failing assertions across read-store and found-store before the persistence fix.
redGreenEvidence.capFailureCases: Two failing assertions across read-store and found-store before live-record protection.

validation.tests: 1312 passed in full sandboxed run; one child-process fixture blocked by EPERM passed when rerun outside the sandbox using existing approval.
validation.ui: Globe drag flow passed; story 1→2→3→2→1 assertions passed; story expansion and Android-back collapse passed.
validation.flowRepair: Extended deck verification accessibility waits from 5 to 15 seconds after a tree-read timeout; assertions unchanged.
validation.runtime: No runtime warnings or errors observed after the clean restart and final flows.

limits: Confirmed these paths with injected transient storage faults and a controlled history-cap test. This does not establish which path caused the user's prior observation. Marks already overwritten on disk cannot be reconstructed.
scope: Read and found stores share the fix. The debounced-write retry also protects other stores using that helper. Existing saved values and keys remain compatible.
performance: Healthy loads do not add disk reads to the normal mark/save path. The separately validated bound Skia-method optimization is retained.
